paragraphs.text: The Church of the Incarnate Soul is a religious organization that worships planeswalkers as gods .
They feel that mana is the essence of the divine, and the more powerful the person, the more divine.
They also have a mastery over magical artifacts unmatched in the multiverse . Because of their intimate knowledge about mana, they can create items like manablades , which they control most of.
The August Questor is the leader of the Church.
